subject: Delay regarding the patio boards
text: Thank you for your patience. I wanted to update you after checking yesterday’s numbers. A replacement bracket for the support frame cost more than I budgeted, and I did not expect to need three of them. I ordered what is required this morning, but the supplier said Tuesday. I can begin again as soon as the parts arrive. I apologize for the delay. I will confirm delivery. The revised timeline should not cause disruption.
